target.title: Acceptance samples: DSH TOP10 plugins (install ≠ run matrix)
target.whyThisThread: an independent DSH-compatible host is recording install-vs-runtime outcomes for the ten most popular plugins; a 'rejected at install' row there becomes ecosystem truth for anyone reading it

contribution.claim: an install outcome depends on three things, only one of which is the plugin: which registry answered, whether the version is inside the release-age window, and the spec form written into the profile
controlsOffered: re-run against registry.npmjs.org instead of the mirror
if either changes the outcome, the row is an environment result, not a compatibility result
contribution.concreteEvidenceCited: 42 minutes after a publish, the mirror served the tarball (302) while its metadata listed only earlier versions, so an exact pin failed with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION

whyItIsNotPromotion: the comment asks the maintainer to change how a row is classified; the only link is a write-up of the timings, offered as a way to avoid rediscovery
risk: the maintainer may consider registry behaviour out of scope for a host-compatibility matrix; the comment explicitly says no action is requested
